create_InMemoryBackendWriter: create an InMemoryBackendWriter to store trajectory step data and episode metadata in RAM
record_step_with_InMemoryBackendWriter: record a StepData object to the InMemoryBackendWriter for a new or continuing episode
set_episode_metadata_on_writer: set arbitrary metadata on the current episode of an InMemoryBackendWriter instance
create_InMemoryBackendReader: create an InMemoryBackendReader from an InMemoryBackendWriter to read back stored steps and episodes
get_episode_info_from_reader: get EpisodeInfo for a specific episode index including start step, length, and metadata
